profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Check Point Software | Computer Science Graduate, Cal Poly SLO
profile.summary: After recently attaining a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science from California Polytechnic State University, San Luis Obispo, I began my journey as a Software Engineer at Grass Valley. My education has provided me with a strong foundation in software development, technical support, and critical thinking. I am eager to apply my technical skills and innovative mindset to contribute to Grass Valley’s success.

positions.title: Software Implementation and Technical Support
positions.locationName: Phoenix, AZ, United States and Las Vegas, NV, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Responsible for the full integration of landscape software for wholly owned Valley Green Landscape, a 25 year old commercial landscape company with 200+ employees operating in Las Vegas, NV and Phoenix, AZ. The software streamlines operations such as estimating, job costing, integration to other applications, reporting and analytics, client and lead management.

Responsibilities:
- Understanding of business requirements and business processes 
- Management and coordination of data 
- Project planning, execution, and presentation
- Implementation both remotely and onsite
- Test the full functional process flow before implementing
- End-User Training on software 
- Other responsibilities include website and IT support
positions.insights: Skills: Project Planning · Data Management · Technical Support · Data Analysis

positions.title: Customer Service
positions.description:
I learned invaluable customer service skills that will serve me well in my professional career in computer science:
- Provide a high level of customer service by assisting customers and assessing their landscaping needs
- Meet and greet customers in a friendly and timely manner
- Provide directions and general assistance
- Effectively market the company while helping customers with the plant selection/delivery of purchases to their vehicles

- Learned to manage a constant flow of customers while also performing job-related duties
- Get things done in a timely manner by utilizing coworker teamwork
- Build relationships with coworkers
- Treat all customers with respect no matter the request at hand
